test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find a single discount (rounded up to two decimal places) to equal three consecutive discounts of 6%, 28% and 15%
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Combine first two discounts: 6 + 28 − (6 × 28) ÷ 100 = 34 − 1.68 = 32.32%.

Combine result with third discount: 32.32 + 15 − (32.32 × 15) ÷ 100.

⇒ 47.32 − 4.848 = 42.472%.

Rounding up to two decimal places, we get 42.47%.

**∴ The correct answer is 42.47%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → Discounts are **6%**, **28%**, and **15%**.
Formulas: **Net SP** = MP × (100 − d₁)% × (100 − d₂)% × (100 − d₃)% | **Single Discount%** = (MP − SP) ÷ MP × 100.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c45deaf7489a661cd4960cd6b407e598e3fd88db6faeae15570b48c19b27f5fd.png] 
⇒ Let **Marked Price (MP)** be 100.
⇒ Final **Selling Price (SP)** = 100 × (94 ÷ 100) × (72 ÷ 100) × (85 ÷ 100).
⇒ SP = 100 × 0.94 × 0.72 × 0.85 = 57.528.
⇒ **Single Equivalent Discount** = 100 − 57.528 = 42.472%.
⇒ Rounding to two decimal places, we get **42.47%**.

**∴ The correct answer is 42.47%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

For two discounts a% and b%, the single effective discount is (a + b − ab/100)%.

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always calculated on the **Marked Price (MP)**. Selling Price = MP − Discount.</p
